# Vendored signature_pad

`signature_pad.umd.min.js` is a verbatim copy of the signature_pad
project's UMD build, redistributed here to avoid third-party CDN
dependencies on the signer landing surface.

* **Version pinned:** signature_pad v5.1.4
* **Source:** <https://unpkg.com/signature_pad@5.1.4/dist/signature_pad.umd.min.js>
* **License:** MIT — see adjacent `LICENSE`.

## Updating

Replace the UMD bundle above with the matching artifact from a newer
tagged release. Do not modify the upstream file locally; glue code
lives in `trustseal-signature.mjs`.
